title: Fix the top findings of the 2026-10-17 full review
description: Follow-ups from the full review of develop at 3c2ed84 (Claude Doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/37d2f3b8-a89b-47ba-8013-989badfc68ff, raw notes under project files reviews/2026-10-17-full-review). Six bugs, each fixed on its own branch with its own PR into develop, Gherkin first.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Working notes for whoever implements these. No code has been written yet: six Opus agents were started and stopped by a rate limit before making any commit, so every child bug starts from origin/develop.

Parallelism: all six touch different files and can run at the same time, one branch and one PR into develop each. Only overlap: chatticus-f47d17 (member identity) and chatticus-dcab9a (worker registration) both edit conversation/src/http, and chatticus-612d1e (computer record writes) and chatticus-16af42 (customer role, if it adds an ExternalId to the organization record) both touch conversation/src/domain; merge order does not matter but expect a trivial rebase.

Priority order if capacity is limited: f47d17 and 16af42 (P0), then 3a9358, 612d1e, dcab9a, 0ee2a2.

Each child issue has the file and line references and the fix. Behavior-driven rule: Gherkin scenario first, then steps, then code; see AGENTS.md. Gates: cd conversation, npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run test:features (needs moto: CHATTICUS_TEST_AWS_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:5555 with moto_server -p 5555 or docker motoserver/moto:5.2.3); infra: cd infra, npm test.

Cloud container caveat: npm ci fails on the web workspace because the anthus-vultus tarball on GitHub returns 403 from the sandbox network. Workaround that worked: git clone AnthusAI/Vultus is also blocked, so use npm ci -w conversation -w host-protocol -w computer/host -w infra --ignore-scripts for everything except web. The web bug (chatticus-3a9358) needs a machine that can reach github.com/AnthusAI/Vultus, or its web gates will have to rely on CI.

Source of findings: Claude Doc https://claude.ai/code/artifact/37d2f3b8-a89b-47ba-8013-989badfc68ff and raw notes in project files under reviews/2026-10-17-full-review/.
